item.title: Request a Quote for WooCommerce (Addify) — Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload (CVE-2026-18143)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2026-18143. Status: PoC. Affects: Request a Quote for WooCommerce plugin (slug: woocommerce-request-a-quote) by Addify, distributed through WooCommerce.com; WordPress + WooCommerce storefront. Tags: arbitrary-file-upload, unauthenticated, WordPress, WooCommerce, plugin, PHP, webshell, CWE-434, admin-ajax, Addify.
